marketplaces.description: The list of country codes representing amazon marketplaces in which the global ad is applicable. For Sponsored Ads, the marketplaces included should either be same as or subset of parent ad group. For ADSP, this represents retail domains such as Amazon.com, Amazon.co.uk, and Amazon.mx, each corresponding to a country where an Amazon customer can shop. The field represents the Amazon marketplaces for the advertised product included in the creative settings.

info.description:
Amazon Ads API v1 is a reimagined approach to our Ads API, built to provide a seamless experience across all Amazon advertising products through a common model. [Learn more about Ads API v1.](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/reference/amazon-ads/overview) To learn about prerequisites and header values, see [Getting started with Amazon Ads API v1](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/reference/amazon-ads/getting-started).

**Download Amazon Ads API V1 OpenAPI Spec** ([All Products](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPIALLMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SP](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISPMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SP Global](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISPGLOBALMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SB](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISBMerged_prod_3p.json) | [DSP](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPIDSPMerged_prod_3p.json) | [ST](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISTMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SD](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISDMerged_prod_3p.json))

post.description:
Create ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "dsp_creatives_edit", "creatives_edit"]

Delete ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit"]

List ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "dsp_creatives_view", "creatives_view", 
"dsp_creatives_edit", "creatives_edit", "advertiser_campaign_view"]

Update ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "dsp_creatives_edit", "creatives_edit"]
